concepts.gloss_en: Tefillin as mochin (the intellects/brain-lights) — the paired node juxtaposing tefillin and mochin per the Kabbalistic identification in Torah lm2:5

members.note: identical two-word form differing only by an inserted comma — pure punctuation/orthographic variant per rule 5

notes: Both surface forms are the same two lexemes (תפלין + מחין); the only difference is a comma. Merged as orthographic variants. Note the two proof quotes emphasize different facets (joy of tefillin vs. tikkun ha-mochin), but the node string itself is identical in both cases, so this does not split the node.
